newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX steams to record close for eighth day.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX steams to record close for eighth day.

text.p: The Austrian ATX index of 21 blue chips extended a rally on Wednesday, ending at a record closing high for the eighth day running and traders forecast the honeymoon would last at least for the next few days.
"It's no longer possible to say what will happen. But the whole market is friendly," said one trader.
"A correction to 1,350 or 1,360 points would be possible but I can't see that happening at the moment because the future continues to be strong," said another.
The ATX closed eight points, or 0.57 percent, higher at 1,399.4, supported by buoyant international leads. The index earlier powered up to an intra-day record high of 1,409.17 points.
Among its constituents were 17 gainers and four losers.
The top ATX gainer was Creditanstalt ordinaries, which added 34 schillings to end at 820.
The leading decliner was VA Tech, dropping 70 schillings to 2,386.
The July ATX future gained 10.6 points to 1,408.1. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
